note: What a server sends to set a unit walking along a path, facing the way it walks. The header names the unit.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: A client reads nothing here and answers nothing.

fields.name: points
x
fields.note: A point on the path, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: A point on the path, in world units.
The path's points, to the end of the message. A client takes the ground's height for each, and passes over a remainder shorter than a point.

revisions.note: A client acknowledges nothing and drops no path as stale. A body shorter than 4 bytes leaves a client failing.
